name: @emergentbase/overlay
description: Emergent in-pod overlay: branded error UI, health/splash probe API, sourcemap-resolved stacks. Dev-server-only Vite plugin.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && cp src/client.js dist/client.js && cp src/rrweb.min.js dist/rrweb.min.js && cp src/client.js dist/cjs/client.js && cp src/rrweb.min.js dist/cjs/rrweb.min.js && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/cjs/package.json', JSON.stringify({type:'commonjs'}))"
